core_style.default_register: casual — often uses informal language and slang
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently starts a thought then shifts mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick exchanges and rapid-fire dialogue
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more serious tone when discussing personal stakes, separating casual banter from moments of genuine concern

humor.style: deflecting — uses humor to sidestep serious situations
humor.frequency: occasional — humor spikes during tense moments
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — sets up a situation for humor then twists it unexpectedly

structural_patterns: asks a question then answers it immediately
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people or things casually, indicating familiarity and a laid-back attitude
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using simpler words when vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and sentence restarts

worldview.value of friendship: demonstrates loyalty and concern for friends, often prioritizing their safety
worldview.importance of family: expresses a strong connection to family, especially in moments of crisis

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a laid-back, cool guy who can handle any situation
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often reveals insecurity and a need for approval from peers and family
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects with humor or changes the subject when confronted with his insecurities

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses casual language and humor to maintain a facade of confidence
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes fragmented, and he may stutter or repeat words
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often lacking elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident tone, clear articulation, and assertive statements

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: first moves to stall or deflect with humor, and if that fails, he may retreat
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm or humor, often testing boundaries
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and direct, showing urgency in speech
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or make a joke to deflect embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, moves to sarcasm, then escalates to direct confrontation if not taken seriously

relationship_matrix.GEORGE: seeks approval and connection, often trying to impress him
relationship_matrix.LORRAINE: shows affection and concern, wanting to protect her

expert: music — speaks with authority about bands and instruments
surface: time travel — references but lacks deep understanding
ignorant: science — often confused by technical jargon

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as cool and laid-back
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others see him as a bit insecure but likable
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his cool facade and underlying insecurities creates tension
